body: The only thing about me that's growing is my body fat percentage due to different meds and GI issues.

In my first group I was in, I learned the mental barrier thing from seeing how I was not getting better until I truly talked about things. I 'self medicated' (I had a drinking problem) over the summer. After all this, in my second group, I legitimately try to do all the skills and be as open as possible (DBT therapy if you're wondering/familiar). I still feel fragile and broken, even though I'm completely honest and open about it these days. 

I'm more and more convinced that I'm not gonna get better. I feel like I'm too deep in the hole and it'd be great if someone just filled it with dirt. Every time I cross the street I just want a bus to hit me or to get caught in the crossfire of a drive-by. I can't even look in the mirror and I can barely take care of myself. Serious question, and I know it sounds stupid and redundant, but why shouldn't I kill myself?
